note: Requirements are transcribed from the owner brief or labeled as proposed acceptance checks. An official context link explains a standard or agency guidance; it does not independently confirm the owner's site conditions or a contractor's agreement.

requirements.requirement: Diagnose the seized bathtub overflow trip-lever/plunger mechanism in concealed plumbing.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor documents the actual mechanism, failure point, and proposed repair before work.
requirements.context_label: Watco typical trip-lever assembly (model-specific; not a diagnosis)

requirements.requirement: Prefer a safe from-above / overflow-opening approach if the contractor can perform it without damaging hidden plumbing.
requirements.acceptance: Written access plan states whether top-down retrieval is feasible and what stops the attempt.
requirements.context_label: Manufacturer installation/adjustment instructions

requirements.requirement: If from-above service is not feasible, plan controlled access from below through the storage-unit ceiling.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor identifies opening location/size, protects storage contents, and keeps access open for testing.
requirements.context_label: SF DBI concealed-pipe guidance

requirements.requirement: One responsible licensed service for plumbing plus drywall opening, patch, texture, and paint restoration.
requirements.acceptance: Single prime contract or written coordinated subcontracting plan names responsibility for every trade and finish.
requirements.context_label: CSLB B classification / two-trade rule

requirements.requirement: Licensed plumbing performer (C-36) and appropriately licensed drywall/building scope as applicable.
requirements.acceptance: Check CSLB status/classifications for the actual contracting entity and crew on hire day.
requirements.context_label: CSLB C-36 plumbing classification

requirements.requirement: Provider confirms service to the specific San Francisco address and the below-unit work area.
requirements.acceptance: Written confirmation of address coverage; city-wide marketing alone is not a booking.
requirements.context_label: CSLB: verify business location and telephone

requirements.requirement: Demonstrated experience with delicate concealed waste-and-overflow / seized trip-lever work.
requirements.acceptance: Comparable job references or documented examples; do not substitute license class or star rating for this evidence.
requirements.context_label: CSLB: ask for recommendations for similar projects

requirements.requirement: Experience and procedures for tenant-occupied work, including scheduling and access coordination.
requirements.acceptance: Named coordinator, agreed access windows, tenant communication plan, and references from occupied units.
requirements.context_label: CSLB: put special requests and instructions in the contract

requirements.requirement: Protect occupants, storage contents, finishes, and adjacent areas from dust, debris, and water.
requirements.acceptance: Written containment, floor/content protection, water control, cleanup, and debris-removal plan.
requirements.context_label: CSLB: include cleanup and special instructions

requirements.requirement: Identify tub/overflow manufacturer, model, and compatible replacement parts before ordering or replacing.
requirements.acceptance: Photos/model markings recorded; proposed parts confirmed compatible by the contractor/manufacturer.
requirements.context_label: Watco model-specific instructions illustrate why identification matters

requirements.requirement: Do not force a seized linkage; stop and re-scope if hidden plumbing damage becomes likely.
requirements.acceptance: Written stop-work threshold and change-order process before additional cutting or pipe replacement.
requirements.context_label: CSLB: changes should be written change orders

requirements.requirement: Inspect concealed plumbing and surrounding materials for leaks or damage while access is open.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor records condition and obtains approval before closing any ceiling or wall.
requirements.context_label: SF DBI: required inspections before covering pipes

requirements.requirement: Verify stopper/drain operation and check drain/overflow connections for leaks before ceiling closure.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor performs functional and leak checks with access open; results documented and any required inspection completed.
requirements.context_label: Watco step 7: readjust until drain stops water

requirements.requirement: Restore ceiling drywall, tape, texture, and paint; assess any required fire-rated assembly or access-panel option.
requirements.acceptance: Restoration scope identifies materials, finish match, assembly requirements, and who performs each step.
requirements.context_label: CSLB C-9 drywall classification

requirements.requirement: Itemized written proposal separating diagnosis/adjustment, replacement, access, restoration, and contingencies.
requirements.acceptance: Compare at least three bids on identical scope; no unsupported total is published here.
requirements.context_label: CSLB: compare at least three written bids on identical scope

requirements.requirement: Confirm the legal entity, scope, date, amount, and inclusions behind each of the three owner-reported estimates.
requirements.acceptance: Original written quotes matched to CSLB entity; unconfirmed amounts remain blank.
requirements.context_label: CSLB official license lookup (identity context only)

requirements.requirement: Verify bond, workers' compensation for the actual crew, and general liability coverage.
requirements.acceptance: Current certificates verified with carrier/agent; exemptions are not treated as proof of crew coverage.
requirements.context_label: CSLB insurance and bond guidance

requirements.requirement: Review CSLB complaint/disclosure information and additional status warnings before selection.
requirements.acceptance: Read the exact regulator record; do not infer wrongdoing beyond the disclosed text.
requirements.context_label: Example: Handyman Heroes CSLB disclosure

requirements.requirement: Determine permit and inspection requirements for the actual proposed scope with San Francisco DBI before work.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor/DBI documents whether the specific work is exempt or requires permits; no blanket exemption is assumed.
requirements.context_label: SF DBI plumbing/mechanical permit guidance

requirements.requirement: Written contract, change orders, payment terms, warranty, cleanup, and access instructions.
requirements.acceptance: Contract names license/entity, complete scope, price, schedule, permits, insurance, and restoration responsibilities.
requirements.context_label: CSLB contract guidance

requirements.requirement: Before/during/after photos and repair/test records without publishing tenant identifiers.
requirements.acceptance: Job record retained privately; public dashboard contains no tenant names, unit address, or private scheduling context.
requirements.context_label: CSLB: written records and contract documentation

requirements.requirement: Use Yelp and other review platforms for discovery and manual reading, not as license or job-fit proof.
requirements.acceptance: Review links supplied; blocked/inconsistent numeric values remain blank and flagged.
requirements.context_label: CSLB: check licenses and references independently

requirements.requirement: Every published data row has a source link; unconfirmed values are blank and appear on Flagged for Review.
requirements.acceptance: Automated row/source and blank-value checks pass before publication.
requirements.context_label: Repository coordination / verification protocol

requirements.requirement: Clean GitHub Pages dashboard with category subpages, executive summary, and verified deployment.
requirements.acceptance: Build and link checks pass; PR merged; exact-commit Pages deployment confirmed.
requirements.context_label: GitHub Pages official documentation
